title: PART 124—COUNTER-UNMANNED AIRCRAFT SYSTEM AUTHORITY FOR STATE, LOCAL, TRIBAL, AND TERRITORIAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AND CORRECTIONAL AGENCIES
f: Implements 6 U.S.C. 124n as amended by the SAFER SKIES Act; related to 49 U.S.C. 44810 (R2-e0b61aab, in sample).
reason: 14 CFR Part 124 (2026) governs counter-UAS detection and mitigation by SLTT agencies: certifications, operations plans, prohibition on action against aircraft 'operated with a human pilot, crew, or passengers onboard'; operators must hold a Part 107 remote pilot certificate.

title: FAR Part 40—Information Security and Supply Chain Security (Subpart 40.2 Security Prohibitions and Exclusions)

reason: FAR Part 40 subpart 40.2: 'executive agencies are prohibited from procuring a FASC-prohibited unmanned aircraft system' and from operating one after 22 Dec. 2025; defines unmanned aircraft as 'operated without the possibility of direct human intervention from within or on the aircraft'.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947 of 24 May 2019 on the rules and procedures for the operation of unmanned aircraft
f: Parent of amendments 2020/639, 2020/746, 2021/1166 (all in sample) and 2022/425; GB retained copy R2-e8e3e681 in sample; companion to 2019/945.
reason: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2019/947, full text: open/specific/certified categories, operator registration, remote pilot competency; defines 'autonomous operation' as one 'during which an unmanned aircraft operates without the remote pilot being able to intervene'.

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945 on unmanned aircraft systems and on third-country operators of unmanned aircraft systems
f: Parent of 2024/1108 (in sample) and 2020/1058; GB retained copy R2-08a1ad4b in sample; standards decision 2024/2103 in sample.
reason: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945, full text: C0-C6 class requirements, remote ID, geo-awareness, third-country operators; 'unmanned aircraft' means any aircraft 'operating or designed to operate autonomously or to be piloted remotely without a pilot on board'.

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1108 of 13 March 2024 amending Regulation (EU) No 748/2012 as regards the initial airworthiness of unmanned aircraft systems subject to certification and Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
f: Part of the 2024 certified-UAS package (2024/1107, 1109 in sample, 1110); amends 748/2012 and 2019/945.
reason: Substantive amendment adding Part 21 airworthiness provisions for certified UAS and control and monitoring units, and amending C1-C3 class requirements ('provide the remote pilot with a clear warning when the battery of the UA or its CMU reaches a low level').

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1109 on competent authority requirements and administrative procedures for continuing airworthiness of certified unmanned aircraft systems
f: Part of the 2024 certified-UAS package with 2024/1107, 1108 (in sample), 1110; amends 2023/203.
reason: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/1109: competent-authority and organisation requirements for continuing airworthiness of certified UAS (Part-CAO.UAS forms, oversight duties); automation content limited to the definition of the CMU as 'the equipment to control unmanned aircraft remotely'.

title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/2103 of 30 July 2024 on harmonised standard for direct remote identification for unmanned aircraft drafted in support of Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/945
f: Ancillary to 2019/945 (in sample); follows standardisation request C(2020) 6148.
reason: [harmonised-standards decision] Commission decision whose only operative content is to publish the reference of EN 4709-002:2023 'with restriction'; carries no rule of its own on UAS and nothing on remote piloting or automation.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1821 amending Implementing Regulation (EU) 2015/1018 as regards Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS), U-space occurrences, part-IS occurrences, and the removal of certain aviation security occurrences from mandatory reporting requirements
f: Amends Implementing Regulation 2015/1018 under Regulation 376/2014; links to 2019/945, 2021/664.
reason: Substantive amendment adding Annex VI of mandatorily reportable UAS occurrences and U-space occurrences; items include 'Misinterpretation of UAS automation mode of functioning' and failure of 'return home, automatic landing, geo-caging, Flight Termination System'.

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/2236 amending Annexes I, II, IV and V to Regulation (EU) 2018/858 as regards technical requirements for vehicles produced in unlimited series, small series, fully automated vehicles in small series, special purpose vehicles, and software update

title: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2024/1329 of 13 May 2024 amending and correcting Implementing Decision (EU) 2023/1586 as regards harmonised standards for machinery
f: Ancillary to Implementing Decision 2023/1586 under Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC (replaced by 2023/1230, in sample).
reason: [harmonised-standards decision] Decision amending the list of harmonised machinery standards; 'driverless industrial trucks' appear only as the title of EN ISO 3691-4:2023 in the list; no rule of its own.

title: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery and repealing Directive 2006/42/EC and Council Directive 73/361/EEC
f: Replaces Directive 2006/42/EC; amended by the Digital Omnibus 2026/1744 (in sample); supported by standards decisions such as 2024/1329 (in sample).
reason: Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, full text (a principal regulation although the study flags it 'amendment'): Annex III requires that 'autonomous mobile machinery ... shall have a supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode' and third-party assessment of 'systems with fully or partially self-evolving behaviour using machine learning approaches ensuring safety functions'.

title: Council Directive 93/42/EEC of 14 June 1993 concerning medical devices

reason: [generic/no embodied provision] Medical Devices Directive 93/42/EEC, full text: no robot, surgical-robot or automation provision; software is mentioned only in the device definition and classification rule 2.3.

title: Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664 of 22 April 2021 on a regulatory framework for the U-space
f: Companion of 2021/665 (in sample) and 2021/666; builds on 2019/947 and 2019/945.
reason: Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/664, full text: UAS flight authorisation, network identification and traffic information obligations on UAS operators and U-space service providers; U-space defined by 'a high degree of automation and digitalisation'; remote pilot position reported.

title: Commission Regulation (EU) 2019/543 of 3 April 2019 amending Annex IV to Regulation (EC) No 661/2009 and Annexes I, III and IV to Directive 2007/46/EC as regards updating the references to and including certain UN ECE Regulations on the type-approval of motor vehicles
f: Amends Annex IV of Regulation 661/2009 and Annexes I, III, IV of Directive 2007/46/EC.

title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958 laying down test procedures and technical requirements for type-approval of intelligent speed assistance systems
f: Delegated act under Regulation 2019/2144 (General Safety Regulation); sits with 2022/1426 on ADS.
reason: Delegated Regulation (EU) 2021/1958, full text: ISA technical requirements, including that the system 'shall attempt to reduce the driving speed to or below the perceived speed limit automatically' and that 'In the case that the system relies on machine learning, or similar, this shall be duly taken into account'.
